decisions.statement: An answer this change's files turn and the change lands nothing for refuses it.
An answer this change lands that its files turn nothing at refuses it too.
The answers the files turn are read off the index the change leaves.
No index is built again here.
Only an index whose own page says git holds it is judged here.
The file of references beside a page is judged here as such an index is.
The file a page carries beside it is judged here as such an index is.
An answer already holding what the change leaves is judged by nothing here.
An answer turned outside the change's own files is judged by nothing here.
This check judges at change and at no other phase.
An audit is a change turning nothing, so there is nothing here for it to judge.
A change taking an answer away that the files turn nothing at is sweeping rather than refused.

definition: the check refusing a change whose index answers differ from what its files turn
